Maya (eng-platform): quick follow-up from the postmortem — our canary for the routing plugin missed a token-rate regression; need owners & timelines.
Aj Patel: ack. immediate wins: auto-rollback on latency/rate anomalies + smaller blast radius for model-routing rollouts.
Leo Zhang: what's the exact failure fingerprint? saw hit-rate jump to 12% errors then p95 spike. similar in prior two incidents.
Sophia Rivera: add metric defs, alert thresholds, playbook. gate flags to non-prod first.
Maya (eng-platform): @Aj draft rollback rules? @Leo own metric sigs? I'll own rollout defaults.
Aj Patel: proposal:
```
canary:
  ramp: 5% -> 20% over 30m
  metrics:
    - p95_latency_ms < 120
    - error_rate < 1%
  rollback_on: any breach for 3 consecutive minutes
  blast_radius: max_instances: 2
```
Aj Patel: rollback behavior: graceful drain then stop, forced at 5m.
Leo Zhang: 2m drain then forced. also add KV cache warmup to avoid cold spikes.
Deploy Bot: deploy 1763456792 by Aj Patel: started canary at 5% for model-routing-v2.
oncall-lucas: same pattern in incident-2026-03-16; suggest monthly recurrence review.
